title: DISPATCH
universal_lens: The structural unification of the matchup engine relies on a bidirectional mapping between offensive and defensive state spaces. By treating trench interactions as coupled dynamical systems, we define an operator that maps raw Next Gen Stats (NGS) into causal chains, ensuring the integrity of the underlying data manifold without hardcoded shortcuts.
gsi_mapping: GSI Bayesian inference is mapped by treating ESPN injury digests and depth charts as time-evolving priors over player availability. The NGS statboards serve as likelihood functions for receiver-versus-corner matchups. Conformal prediction intervals are implicitly enforced by requiring a minimum number of non-empty causal chains to validate the predictive output.
gse_mapping: In GSE, situational reasoning is modeled via discrete state transitions driven by bidirectional trench metrics. The removal of premature loop breaks ensures the Markov chain of game states fully explores the sample space. QB time-to-throw acts as the transition probability kernel linking offensive line performance to downstream receiving outcomes.

primitives.name: Bidirectional Trench Coupling Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: Remove premature loop break at line 287; activate coverage injury branches; implement bidirectional trench matchups (`HOME-OL vs AWAY-FRONT` and `AWAY-OL vs HOME-FRONT`) with QB time-to-throw and RB rushing metrics.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: T_HA: Home OL vs Away Front interaction strength (dimensionless index). t_throw: QB time-to-throw (seconds). Y_rush: RB rushing yield (yards).
primitives.assumptions: Assumes linear superposition of offensive line pressure and defensive front resistance dictates the time-to-throw distribution.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down when schematic mismatches (e.g., exotic blitzes) introduce non-linear discontinuities not captured by standard NGS trench metrics.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a coupled oscillator system in GSE, where the phase difference between HOME-OL and AWAY-FRONT determines the energy transfer (QB time-to-throw).
layer2.telemetry: Variance reduction in QB time-to-throw predictions when using bidirectional inputs versus unidirectional baselines.

primitives.name: Causal Chain Integrity Validator
primitives.verbatim_quote: Verify that ALL 14 matchup files have `chains_count >= 2` (zero games with 0 or 1 chain) and contain genuine, non-empty, file-cited causal chains.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: N_chains: Number of valid causal chains per matchup (integer). L_cite: Length of file citation trace (tokens).
primitives.assumptions: Assumes that a minimum threshold of causal depth (>= 2) is required to distinguish signal from stochastic noise in sports analytics.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails if the underlying data sources (NGS/ESPN) lack sufficient granularity to construct two independent causal pathways for a specific matchup.

layer2.mapping: Acts as a derived kernel in GSI, filtering out low-information matchups to maintain the conformal coverage of the overall predictive ensemble.
layer2.telemetry: Percentage of generated reports passing the chains_count >= 2 threshold without manual intervention.

primitives.name: Alias Normalization Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: Normalize player and team aliases (`WAS` -> `WSH`, `AZ` -> `ARI`, GSIS IDs).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: A_raw: Raw alias string (e.g., 'WAS'). A_norm: Normalized GSIS ID (e.g., 'WSH').
primitives.assumptions: Assumes a bijective mapping exists between all legacy abbreviations and the canonical GSIS identifier space.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularities occur when new franchise relocations or mergers introduce aliases not present in the static normalization dictionary.

layer2.mapping: Mathematically equivalent to a coordinate transformation in GSE, aligning disparate data manifolds (ESPN, NGS) onto a unified topological space.
layer2.telemetry: Zero collision rate during the ingestion of multi-source JSON statboards.

The derivation of the Galaxy Sports Edge primitives begins with the fundamental requirement of data integrity, explicitly forbidding hardcoded results or facade implementations. This mandates a rigorous mathematical treatment of the input data manifold. We first establish a coordinate transformation via the Alias Normalization Kernel, mapping heterogeneous identifiers (ESPN, NGS) onto a unified GSIS topological space. Once the domain is normalized, we ingest time-evolving priors from injury digests and depth charts. The core dynamical operator is the Bidirectional Trench Coupling. Unlike traditional unidirectional models, this operator treats the offensive line and defensive front as a coupled system. The state transition is governed by the QB time-to-throw, which acts as a latent variable mediating the interaction between trench metrics and downstream receiving outcomes. To ensure the epistemic validity of the generated matchup reports, we apply the Causal Chain Integrity Validator. This acts as a filter on the output space, rejecting any matchup analysis that fails to produce at least two distinct, file-cited causal chains. This threshold prevents the model from relying on superficial correlations, forcing it to uncover deeper structural dependencies within the NGS statboards. The removal of premature loop breaks further ensures that the Markovian exploration of game states is exhaustive, preventing early convergence on suboptimal predictive paths.

reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: This framework inherits from classical game theory's minimax theorems, adapted for modern high-dimensional sports telemetry. It echoes the evolution from simple box-score regressions to complex agent-based modeling. The explicit prohibition against 'cheating' mirrors the historical shift in quantitative finance from curve-fitting to robust, stress-tested stochastic calculus, ensuring the primitives remain grounded in observable physical constraints rather than statistical artifacts. Retrocausal Genealogy: Rooted in DISPATCH (59fa27dae3114c24), this derivation preserves strict unit consistency, explicit validity boundaries, zero-leakage temporal separation, and bounded structural integration across GSI calibration heads, spectral orthogonalization clusters, and GSE Stage-2 situational reasoning families without fabricating parameters.
reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: We model the opposing agents—specifically the offensive coordinator and defensive play-caller—as rational actors optimizing their respective state transitions. The bidirectional trench coupling assumes both sides dynamically adjust their strategies based on real-time feedback loops (e.g., pass rush success altering protection schemes). The engine must anticipate these adaptive responses, treating the matchup not as a static comparison of talent, but as a dynamic博弈 (game) where each side attempts to exploit the other's structural weaknesses identified in the NGS data.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: To prevent leakage and collinearity, a strict cross-layer veto is applied. If the causal chains derived from trench metrics are highly correlated with those from receiver-versus-corner matchups, the model flags a potential multicollinearity issue. Furthermore, any attempt to bypass the mandatory reading of the original request or project documentation triggers an immediate integrity violation. This ensures that the higher-level strategic reasoning (GSE) remains strictly decoupled from lower-level data ingestion errors, maintaining the orthogonality of the predictive features.
